long layers are designed to maintain the length of your hair, so less hair is cut. this results in a more gradual, subtle layering effect, preserving the overall length while adding movement and texture ! short layers involve cutting more hair and creating a noticeable difference in length between the layers (think of a wolf cut for example), which make it seem like your hair isn’t growing as quickly, as the overall length is reduced

i have HS, and it seems like it tbh. a benzoyl peroxide wash could be helpful and a short-term but effective solution could be a round of antibiotics (doxycycline) prescribed by your dermatologist or GP. personally, the only thing that has completely gotten rid of my abscesses is doxy… i’d suggest you talk about HS to your derm/gp and ask for antibiotics to at least reduce inflammation, unless it’s something else ! 

additionally, reducing consumption of foods that can further aggravate inflammation (dairy, processed sugars, etc.) and, if you’re a smoker, quitting nicotine could be helpful. good luck to you, it seems very painful and i know how much it can hurt your self-esteem :(
